_source: Answers written from lexmakesit.com facts (read 2026-11-22) and deploy/business_profile.json. Nothing here may claim a fact the site does not state; unknowns point to the free call.

q: what kind of company is this
entries.a: LexMakesIt builds websites, custom apps, and A I tools for local businesses, like this phone receptionist. What kind of business do you have?

q: am I talking to a robot
entries.a: I'm LexMakesIt's A I receptionist. Alex built me, and I run on a small computer right here in the office. I can answer questions or book you a free call with Alex.

q: who will I be working with
entries.a: LexMakesIt is run by Alex, who builds every project. You'd talk with Alex directly on a free call.

q: why should I pick you over wix
why hire you instead of a website builder
how is this better than godaddy
why not use wix or godaddy
entries.a: With a website builder, you do the work yourself. LexMakesIt builds it for you, sets it up for your business, and manages it for ten dollars a month. Want to talk it over on a free call?

q: how long does a website take
how long does a project take
entries.a: It depends on the project, so Alex gives you a timeline on the free call. Want me to book that for you?

q: can you help with facebook posts
can you handle my social media posts
do you do content for social media
entries.a: We set up content and posting automation, so your posts go out on schedule without you doing it by hand. Want to go over what you need on a free call?

q: can you build me an app for my restaurant
can you make an app for my shop
can you build software for my business
entries.a: Yes, custom apps and business software are part of what we build, including point of sale systems. What should the app do for you?

q: do you do point of sale systems
can you set up a register system
can you build a checkout system
entries.a: Yes, LexMakesIt builds custom point of sale systems for local businesses. Want to book a free call to go over yours?

q: can I get a receptionist like you
how does this AI receptionist work
can you set this up for my business
I want an AI to answer my phone
how much is an AI receptionist
entries.a: Yes, I'm an example of what LexMakesIt can set up for you. I answer calls, answer questions, and book appointments. Pricing depends on your business, so let's book a free call.

q: what is missed call text back
can it text people I missed
what happens if I miss a call
entries.a: Missed call text back sends the caller a text automatically when you can't pick up, so you don't lose the customer.

q: can you get me more google reviews
entries.a: Yes, we set up automatic review requests, so happy customers get a quick text asking for a review.

q: can you set up my google business profile
can you get me on google maps
my shop isn't showing up on google
customers can't find me on google
can you put my business on google
entries.a: Yes, Google listing setup is one of our services, so customers can find you on search and maps.

q: can my clients get a text before appointments
can you remind my customers about their appointment
entries.a: Yes, we set up appointment reminders, so customers get a text before their visit and fewer people miss it.
We build self updating inventory, so your stock counts keep themselves current as you sell.

q: can you teach me to use AI
entries.a: Yes, Alex teaches automation sessions for one hundred dollars per session. Want to book one?

q: can I see an example first
entries.a: Yes, the first conversation is free, and so is the demo homepage. Want me to book that call?

q: what does the ten dollars a month cover
what is the monthly fee for
do I have to pay monthly
entries.a: The ten dollars a month covers managing your website after it's built. Alex can go over the details on a free call.

q: do you only work with small businesses
do you work with big companies
what kind of businesses do you work with
entries.a: LexMakesIt focuses on local businesses in Paterson, Passaic County, and North Jersey. What kind of business do you have?

q: do you work with people outside new jersey
do I have to meet in person
entries.a: We focus on North Jersey, but Alex can tell you on a free call whether your project is a fit.
